unite_adi: REGULAR UPPER SECONDARY-YEAR 12-LEVEL: B1.4 THEME 2: PERSONAL LIFE & WELL-BEING

bolumler.ogrenmeKanitlari: PERFORMANCE ASSIGNMENT: Students will explore the theme ''Personal life and well-being'' with a focus on the sub-themes of providing personal well-being through social health and providing personal well-being with economic stability, including topics such as fashion addiction and shopaholics. Students will prepare a research-based presentation that examines how maintaining strong social connections contributes to emotional and mental health. They will also analyse the economic aspects of personal well-being, discussing the impact of shopping or excessive spending on fashion, individual stability and societal norms. The project should include practical strategies for achieving a balanced lifestyle, such as budgeting techniques, fostering meaningful relationships, and setting healthy boundaries with consumer habits. Students will conclude their assignment by proposing actionable steps for maintaining personal well-being in a socially and economically sustainable way. The assignment will be evaluated by using a rubric scheme, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme. Öğrenme-Öğretme Yaşantıları
bolumler.temelKabuller: This theme includes the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as providing personal well-being through social health; providing personal well-being with economic stability (fashion addicts, shopaholics)'' and it is assumed that it could be present in almost all languages, with some exceptions. It is assumed that a student of an upper secondary school in year 12 may know what providing personal well-being through social health; providing personal well-being with economic stability (fashion addicts, shopaholics) mean in their own language as it is known that almost all people who start to learn a new language bring their pre-existing knowledge (in their own language) with them and transfer it to their new language learning context. However, they may not know how to say these things in a foreign language if this has not yet been covered in their existing curriculum. Fortunately, this existing knowledge in their own language can help them recognise, understand, and learn them more easily in a foreign language, in this case English. As they are students of an upper secondary school in year 12, they are expected to know some basic vocabulary about ''personal life and well-being'' in English from previous themes and/or years such as ''strength, flexibility, self-esteem, to cope with'' and also some structures such as ''She was cycling yesterday morning to stay fit. They included vitamins and minerals in his balanced diet last month.'' in English from the previous themes and/ or years. These grammar items and vocabulary are revised during the ''Revision Programme'' at the beginning of the year and they can be used as a basis for learning the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme, so that the new grammatical elements in the current theme can be learnt easily.
bolumler.onDegerlendirme: It is assumed that these students in an upper secondary school are ready to learn the concept of ''personal life and well-being with its components such as providing personal well-being through social health; providing personal well-being with economic stability (fashion addicts, shopaholics)'' cognitively, affectively, and socially since it is appropriate to their age and language level. Therefore, a contextual poster or a large picture could be provided for the students to remember and practise the items that they are related and previously learnt so that they can discuss the poster and/or the picture in pairs and write down what they remember. This session can help them revise all the related vocabulary and grammatical elements that they have already learnt from previous themes or from previous years as a preparatory practice. In this way, their performance can be evaluated in terms of how much they remember and how accurately they use these items to build their competence in the current theme. It can help the teacher decide what to emphasise, revise, and practise in order to facilitate the new vocabulary and grammatical items in the current theme. (Their performance can be evaluated by rubrics, a rating scale, and/or a marking scheme during these practices.).
bolumler.zenginlestirme: Objective: To talk about personal well-being or economic stability in English through their speaking skills by using target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Create and Report Students work in pairs to create their own sentences about personal well-being or economic stability using vocabulary from the list (e.g., to create a budget, to invest for the future, empathy). One student shares their sentence aloud (e.g., ''I think people should limit social media usage to avoid unnecessary shopping''), and their peer reports it using reported speech (e.g., She said that people should limit social media usage to avoid unnecessary shopping). They take turns creating and reporting, making sure to use the target vocabulary. The teacher gives feedback on vocabulary use, grammar, and pronunciation. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
bolumler.destekleme: Objective: To talk about personal well-being through social health in English through a pair work activity by using the target vocabulary and target grammar. Activity 1: Report It Right The teacher writes sentences such as ''I am obsessed with fast fashion'' and ''I will create a budget to cut expenses'' on papers and places them in a box. Students work in pairs, taking turns to draw a paper, read the sentence aloud, and have their peer report it by using reported speech (e.g., She said she was obsessed with fast fashion). They continue until all papers are used, practicing speaking and listening while learning reported speech. After each pair performs, the teacher provides constructive feedback focusing on pronunciation and sentence accuracy. Students reflect on their thoughts and feelings about the activity.
